collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).
collection.description: Two children weave crowns from fallen blossoms.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: Two children weave crowns from fallen blossoms. They crown each other with great ceremony.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: Two children weave crowns from fallen blossoms. One crown is too big and slides down over a nose, causing giggles.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: Two children weave crowns from fallen blossoms. They give one to an elder, who wears it all afternoon.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: Two children weave crowns from fallen blossoms. A bee investigates the crowns, and the children stand very still until it leaves.
